sentences.text: Sheyi Emmanuel Adebayor -LRB- -LSB- ɛmanɥɛl adəbɛjɔʁ -RSB- ; born 26 February 1984 -RRB- is a Togolese professional footballer who plays as a striker for Turkish club İstanbul Başakşehir .	İstanbul Başakşehir	Başakşehir F.K.	footballer	association football	striker	Forward (association football)#Striker

He previously played for English clubs Arsenal , Manchester City , Tottenham Hotspur and Crystal Palace , as well as French sides Metz and Monaco and Spanish team Real Madrid .	Metz	FC Metz	Monaco	AS Monaco FC	Arsenal	Arsenal F.C.	Manchester City	Manchester City F.C.	Real Madrid	Real Madrid C.F.	Tottenham Hotspur	Tottenham Hotspur F.C.	Crystal Palace	Crystal Palace F.C.
He was voted African Footballer of the Year for 2008 .	African Footballer of the Year	African Footballer of the Year

Adebayor represented the Togo national team at the 2006 FIFA World Cup in Germany , the country 's debut , and to date only , appearance at the World Cup .	Togo	Togo national football team	Togo national team	Togo national football team	2006 FIFA World Cup	2006 FIFA World Cup	Germany	Germany	World Cup	FIFA World Cup

In January 2010 , Adebayor was one of the players involved when the Togo team 's bus came under gunfire on the way to the 2010 Africa Cup of Nations in Angola , after which he retired from national team duty . In 2013 , he returned to the Togo team for the 2013 African Cup of Nations in South Africa , where he helped them to qualify for the quarter-finals .	Togo	Togo national football team	2013 African Cup of Nations	2013 African Cup of Nations
